name_note: The genomes GTDB places in s__Acetatifactor hominis carry the NCBI name Waltera hominis; no retrieved paper describes that species itself, so these sentences describe the genus Waltera.

sentences.text: Three strains isolated from faecal samples of healthy Japanese people were obligately anaerobic, Gram-stain-negative wavy rods assigned to the genus Waltera.
Brotolimicola acetigignens was transferred to the genus Waltera as Waltera acetigignens because the genus Waltera has priority.
Waltera species were among difficult-to-culture organisms obtained from several faecal samples using a co-culture method.
